headlines.shortLinkText: Jaylen Brown scores season-high 30 points and makes key block in 76ers' 112-106 win over Pistons

headlines.description: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 26 points to lead the Atlanta Hawks to a 120-105 victory over the Washington Wizards and former Hawks star guard Trae Young on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alexander-Walker scores 26, Hawks down Trae Young's Wizards 120-105

headlines.description: — Paul George scored 25 points and had five 3-pointers, Derrick White added 24 points and seven assists, and the Boston Celtics beat the Milwaukee Bucks 109-102 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: George and White leads Celtics past Bucks, 109-102

headlines.description: — Michael Porter Jr. had 26 points and 10 rebounds and Julius Randle added 22 points as the Brooklyn Nets won their second game of the season, 114-104 over the Charlotte Hornets on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porter and Randle power the Nets to their 2nd win of the season, 114-104 over the Hornets

events.name: Chicago Bulls at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson scored 33 points as the New York Knicks routed the Chicago Bulls 135-105 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 33 points, leads the Knicks to a 135-105 win over the Bulls

headlines.description: — Andrew Nembhard scored 22 points, Aaron Nesmith had 16, including a 3-pointer in the closing seconds, and the Indiana Pacers beat the Memphis Grizzles 107-103 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nembhard scores 22, Nesmith hits a late 3-pointer to lead Pacers past Grizzlies 107-103

events.name: Utah Jazz at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Saddiq Bey closed out a 22-point performance with six straight points in the final minutes of overtime, and the New Orleans Pelicans rallied to defeat the Utah Jazz 120-113 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williamson's 23 points and Bey's clutch scoring lift the Pelicans past the Jazz, 120-113 in overtime

events.name: Cleveland Cavaliers at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 42 points and eight assists and the Oklahoma City Thunder withstood a late rally and beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 124-116 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander's 42 points help Thunder to a 124-116 win over the Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Ayo Dosunmu had 21 points and Jonathan Kuminga powered a fourth-quarter run that allowed the Minnesota Timberwolves to pull away for a 117-107 win over the Houston Rockets on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dosunmu scores 21 and Kuminga sparks late surge in Timberwolves’ 117-107 win over Rockets

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 32 points, 11 assists and 10 rebounds for his third triple-double this season to lead the Denver Nuggets over the Toronto Raptors 128-109 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic scores 32 in 3rd triple-double this season as Nuggets roll to 128-109 win over Raptors

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Damian Lillard scored 25 points and Donovan Clingan added 24 to help the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Phoenix Suns 132-119 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lillard and Clingan power Trail Blazers past Suns 132-119 to win 5th in a row on road

events.name: Dallas Mavericks at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had a career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds along with eight blocks to power the San Antonio Spurs past the Dallas Mavericks 112-111 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama has career highs of 52 points, 24 rebounds as Spurs hold off Mavericks 112-111

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Sacramento Kings

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic scored 40 points for his sixth straight game with at least 35, and the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Sacramento Kings 116-103 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic's 40 points lead the Lakers past the Kings 116-103

headlines.description: — Klay Thompson made the winning 3-pointer with a second left in overtime and the Miami Heat rallied past the reeling Los Angeles Clippers 117-116 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Klay Thompson hits winning 3 with a second left in OT as Heat rally past skidding Clippers 117-116
